name: Better Auth
description: Standalone Better Auth server: email/password + Google/GitHub social providers, magic-link plugin, built-in rate limiting, typed auth client, and core DB schema + migration

questions.prompt: Enable Better Auth built-in rate limiting?

checklist: Install dependencies: npm install better-auth (plus your adapter, e.g. drizzle-orm or @prisma/client)
Set BETTER_AUTH_URL to your deployment URL
Wire your database adapter in src/lib/auth.ts (selected: prisma/drizzle/kysely)
Run npx @better-auth/cli generate to emit the authoritative schema for your adapter, then apply src/db/migrations/0001_better_auth.sql (or your migration tool)
Set social provider credentials for the providers you enabled; remove unused providers from src/lib/auth.ts
For magic-link, implement sendMagicLink() in src/lib/auth.ts using your email transport
Built-in rateLimit is enabled per the rate_limiting answer — if you also add the standalone rate-limiting template, reconcile the two
Standalone framework — conflicts with all Group A adapters and the other Group B frameworks; use only one auth strategy
Test flow: sign up with email/password, then GET /api/auth/get-session returns the session; social sign-in redirects through /api/auth/*
